data_fields.name: keep_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.1 (keep current victim while rival is at or under this share of its threat)

data_fields.name: heal_threat_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 x heal x spell threat multiplier, split across haters

best_idea: Keep the current target until a rival has more than 110 percent of its threat (130 percent if the rival is at range), with taunt and suppression applied first, and drop an unreachable target after 10 seconds so the next hater takes over or the NPC goes home.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a hate list and target pick inside the engine for many-on-one; the 110/130 hold is a cheap anti flip-flop rule that fits the three-attacker cap; GPL-2.0 means clean-room only, and the null dereference in getThreat and the dead Timeout column are fixed in the rewrite.
acceptance: Server test: a melee rival at 115 percent of the current victim takes over, a ranged rival at 115 percent does not (needs 130), a taunted hater takes over at any threat, and an NPC whose only hater is unreachable for 10 s goes home while one with two haters drops the first and attacks the second.
